content.description: Waya Collective is a multi-brand company building a new wave of loved African consumer brands in the fashion & lifestyle sector. At Waya Collective, we show that Made in Africa can be competitive, in quality and in price. Africa's manufacturing potential is huge, yet dismissed by most brands. Use your opportunity to build your supply chain in Africa by partnering with us. We are building Africa's Industry, One Product at a Time.
